name: Core-balance current transformer
summary: A core-balance CT measures residual current from the net magnetic effect of conductors passing through its window.
description: A core-balance CT measures residual current from the net magnetic effect of conductors passing through its window. It is used with earth-fault protection where the conductor arrangement and sheath routing affect the measurement.
readingNotes: Verify the included conductors and cable-sheath treatment against the protection scheme.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A CBCT measures a combined residual quantity; a phase CT measures an individual conductor current.
